props.title: A duo through dinner, a DJ to close.
props.lede: A Denver holiday party has two halves: dinner, which has to work at conversation volume, and a dance floor that has to fill. The pairing that covers both is a duo through cocktails and dinner with a DJ carrying the back half, through one sound system on one contract.

props.html: Still at the ideas stage? Seven holiday party ideas, from the DJ night to live band karaoke, are written up on the blog.

When one act should carry the whole night instead, Tejas Singh starts as a duo and finishes as a quartet on a single contract, with the same voice out front all night. Either way it’s one sound system and one invoice, and the handoff is planned so the music runs from the first drink to the last song.

props.title: Downtown hotels and clubs.
props.lede: Denver's December concentrates in the hotels off 17th Street, the Brown Palace and the Oxford among them, with the Four Seasons a few blocks south and the club floors at the University Club of Denver and the Denver Athletic Club holding the member events. One kind of night runs through all of them: a program with remarks in it, dinner at conversation volume, and a dance floor that has to fill once the program ends.

items.q: What does setup look like at a downtown Denver hotel?
items.a: Through the dock and the service elevator, inside the windows the venue sets, and the banquet team wants footprint, power and timing before either is confirmed, so we settle all three before the day. A quartet takes about 14 by 10 feet, 90 minutes and two dedicated 20-amp circuits; a duo takes 8 by 6 feet, one circuit and an hour. Sharing a circuit with catering warmers is the usual cause of trouble, so ask for dedicated lines. Signet Artists books company parties across Denver.
Through dinner and the remarks, quiet enough that a table talks across it; once the program ends, a quartet or the DJ plays like a dance floor, up to what the hotel allows.

items.q: Do December dates in Denver cost more?
items.a: Yes. December weekends usually cost more than a standard date across Colorado, and New Year's Eve is a peak date of its own. Send us the date and we'll come back with a price.
